Your plan in this lab

  1. 1Run the race
  2. 2Pause on the stale response
  3. 3Read the async call stack

You type react, but the list shows results for re.

Why?

The Search box calls onInput twice, for re and then for react.

The Server answers react first.

The re response comes back late.

The Sources panel has three parts.

The Navigator lists the files.

The Editor shows the code.

The Debugger shows Breakpoints, Scope and Call Stack.

A Breakpoint pauses the page,

so you can read Scope and the Call Stack.

A Logpoint never pauses.

It prints a message in the Console.

In this lab you run the race,

pause on the stale response, and read the async call stack.
